principle: A primitive passing in isolation does not imply that its composition is supported. Every listed cross-primitive composition has one declared owner and an explicit verification strategy.

combinations.contract: Nested overlays inherit logical ownership, stack above their owner family, and do not dismiss the owner as an outside interaction.
combinations.verify: layer-family ordering and nested overlay interaction regression

combinations.contract: Destroy cancels ownership immediately; late resolve/reject cannot write state or emit success/error into the destroyed owner.
Logical open state is independent from visual settle; portal ownership remains stable through enter/leave/reversal.
combinations.verify: motion hook safety plus overlay lifecycle regression

combinations.owner: Table edit transaction + Virtualizer stable row key
combinations.contract: An active editor is keyed by stable row/column identity. A renderer change may rebind presentation but cannot silently commit or discard draft state.
Drag records sourceKey rather than sourceIndex and cancels when dataVersion invalidates the logical source.
Form ownership is taken from the authored field/form attribute, not from the portal DOM ancestry of popup controls.
Only one primary visual focus owner is projected; descendant real focus suspends the parent virtual ring without losing logical active identity.
Nested blockers share/ref-count lock ownership and restore only mutations still owned by QX.
